cd "$HOME/Documents/PlatformIO/Projects/ml"; python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter
print('=== REPO CODE SHAPE ===')
for root in ['src','lib','ml','scripts','test','tools','web']:
 p=Path(root)
 if not p.exists(): continue
 files=[x for x in p.rglob('*') if x.is_file()]
 code=[x for x in files if x.suffix.lower() in {'.cpp','.cc','.c','.h','.hpp','.py','.js','.ts','.svelte','.sh','.cmake'}]
 print(f'{root}|files={len(files)}|code={len(code)}')
print('=== LARGE CODE FILES WHOLE REPO ===')
rows=[]
for root in ['src','lib','ml','scripts','tools','web']:
 p=Path(root)
 if not p.exists(): continue
 for x in p.rglob('*'):
  if x.is_file() and x.suffix.lower() in {'.cpp','.cc','.c','.h','.hpp','.py','.js','.ts','.svelte','.sh'}:
   try: n=sum(1 for _ in x.open(errors='ignore'))
   except OSError: continue
   rows.append((n,str(x)))
for n,p in sorted(rows,reverse=True)[:50]: print(f'{n:5d} {p}')
PY
